input: Find general day camps, Parks & Recreation camps, summer childcare, YMCA and Boys & Girls Club summer camps and summer programs for kids and teens in or near Waynesville, Canton, Clyde, Maggie Valley and Lake Junaluska, NC (Haywood County). Search the web thoroughly (several searches with different wording and town names) and list every organization you find.

candidates.name: Town of Waynesville Parks & Recreation
candidates.note: Summer Basecamp day camp; summer 2026 registration confirmed.

candidates.name: Town of Canton Parks & Recreation
candidates.note: Summer day camp at Recreation Park with crafts, games and swimming, grouped by incoming grade.

candidates.name: Smoky Mountain Sk8way & Fun Zone
candidates.note: Summer camp with skating, games, crafts, STEAM activities and local outings; official page announces 2027.

candidates.name: Jonathan Valley Elementary School
candidates.note: School-run summer camp; registration opens annually after spring break.

candidates.name: Camp Ability of WNC
candidates.note: Two-week summer day camp for ages 6–18 with special needs and individual buddy support; 2025 program listed.

candidates.name: Haywood Haven
candidates.note: Summer 2025 program for kindergarten–sixth grade, Tuesdays and Thursdays, 8:30 a.m.–3 p.m.

candidates.name: Haywood County 4-H — N.C. Cooperative Extension
candidates.note: 2026 Summer Fun includes sewing and cooking day camps, electricity camp, archery clinics and evening crafts.

candidates.name: Haywood County Soil and Water Conservation District
candidates.note: One-week Youth Environmental Stewardship day camp for rising eighth and ninth graders, with field trips and hands-on activities.

candidates.name: First United Methodist Church of Waynesville
candidates.note: Creation Care Camp ran July 20–24, 2026, for third–fifth graders, with environmental activities, field trips and play.
